bar: Weakly sourced. (2) Cash: $18.7M cash incl. restricted at 30 Jun 2026, Q2 free cash outflow ~$10M, management guided ~$8M/quarter for H2 (https://investors.imdxinc.com/news-releases/2026/08-10-2026-210715920).
positioning_check: Short interest 1.03M shares, 10.21% of float (float only ~10.0M of 32.7M shares out), 3.13% of shares outstanding, 3.99 days to cover, up from 949,512 the prior month (stockanalysis.com statistics page read 2026-11-16, settlement date not shown: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/imdx/statistics/). findings.finding: The FDA de novo timeline for GraftAssureDx has slipped past the 2026 target: the 10 Aug 2026 8-K disclosed an FDA Additional Information request with a 180-day response window (i.e. up to late January 2027) and one more FDA meeting expected before Q4, and the 14 Oct 2026 sales-leader release no longer mentions a 2026 launch, tying the goal to 'disrupting transplanted organ health testing in 2027'; the Q3 release/call is the first formal update on whether the response has been filed and whether authorization is now a 2027 event, against a Q2-call bar of authorization targeted before year-end 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FDA/launch timing has been the stock's driver: after the Aug 2026 print disclosing the AI request the stock fell 7.13%; after the May 2026 print (submission completed, review under way) it rose 25.88%; after March 2026 (10-K) it fell 13.38% (sealed baseline). Median absolute reaction 10.66%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -30% over 20 sessions and at a 52-week low, which is what the market pricing a delay would look like. What is not priced is the explicit restatement: no company document since August has said authorization moves to 2027, sell-side targets still average $8.25 (4x spot) and consensus is Buy, which would not survive a formal 2027 guide unchanged. Upside path inside the same line: if the call says the AI response is filed and the FDA meeting went well, a beaten-down name with a 10M float can rally hard (May 2026 +25.9%).
findings.independence: The 14 Oct 2026 release (https://finviz.com/news/402324/imdx-welcomes-new-diagnostics-sales-leader-to-prepare-for-planned-graftassuredx-launch) is a different company document pointing the same way (2027 language, 'awaiting regulatory authorization', no date). Both are company sources; no FDA database entry for an authorization was found.

findings.finding: Cash is nearly exhausted going into the print: $18.7M cash incl. restricted at 30 Jun 2026 and management-guided H2 burn of ~$8M/quarter imply roughly $10-11M at 30 Sep and about one quarter of runway, on a ~$65M market cap with a 10M share float; the Q3 10-Q will show the number and likely substantial-doubt language, and a dilutive raise (the February 2026 registered direct was priced at $5.75, nearly 3x today's $2.01) is the obvious next step, plausibly announced alongside or right after the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print paired with an offering in the five post-rename prints. The Feb 2026 $26M registered direct (with Bio-Rad participating) was priced at $5.75; the stock has fallen ~65% since. Q2 2026 print, which showed the $10M quarterly burn, drew -7.13%.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public but the stock still carries a Buy consensus and an $8.25 average target, and the August 10-Q's forward-looking statements already list 'our ability to continue as a going concern'. If a raise were fully priced the shares would trade near a discounted deal price with the overhang removed; instead the deal has not happened and its size/price are unknown. What the money buys (rule: financing is a question): there is no ramp to fund yet; management says no material kit revenue until FDA authorization, which has slipped (finding 1), and Q2 revenue was $239K, so the raise funds survival to authorization rather than visible demand. That answer keeps the sign negative. Not a crowded short (10% of float, 4 days), so the squeeze offset is modest.
findings.independence: A third-party summary of the Q2 call (https://briefglance.com/articles/imdx-nears-fda-goal-line-as-financial-clock-ticks-louder) independently computes runway of 'just over two quarters' from 30 June at the guided ~$8M/quarter. The 10-Q cover (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1642380/000164238026000011/imdx-20260630.htm) shows $17.8M balance-sheet cash and 32.7M shares. Shares the cash facts with finding 1's call but rests on a different line (cash burn, not FDA).

findings.finding: Amendment No. 2 to the 2021 Chronix merger agreement (signed 15 Sep 2026, 8-K filed 21 Sep) replaces the remaining earnout with a 10% royalty on CNI Monitor sales and a final payment of 10% of gross proceeds if CNI Monitor is sold to a third party; this likely produces a non-cash contingent-consideration remeasurement in Q3 GAAP (contingent consideration was $40.2M at 30 Jun, with a $2.3M remeasurement loss in Q2) and signals the company is preparing to sell CNI Monitor rights, a possible non-dilutive cash source.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Contingent-consideration swings have moved GAAP EPS sharply (Q2 2026 GAAP loss $0.31 vs non-GAAP $0.23) with no visible reaction attributable to them; the stock trades on FDA and cash.
findings.why_not_priced: A quiet Item 1.01 8-K with no press release found; no aggregator or news coverage surfaced. Its value is non-cash unless a CNI Monitor sale is announced, which is why it is sized as a fraction; a sale announced with the print would be the only path to a larger move.

findings.finding: CareDx, the dd-cfDNA transplant-testing incumbent, reported on 29 Oct 2026 (after iMDx last spoke) Q3 transplant testing volume of ~50,750 tests, up ~21% year on year, testing services revenue +65%, and guided Q4 transplant tests to 61,000-63,000: the market iMDx's GraftAssure targets is growing strongly under the July 2026 MolDX LCD.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed iMDx reaction to peer prints; iMDx's own transplant revenue is a few hundred thousand dollars a quarter, so the transmission is to the narrative, not the reported quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: IMDX fell ~30% while its addressable market's leader posted a blowout; the read-through is a proxy (macro-to-company transmission not confirmed by iMDx) and cuts both ways since CareDx is the competitor a kit would displace, hence small.
findings.independence: Proxy. Secondary coverage of the same CareDx release: https://www.genomeweb.com/business-news/strong-test-sales-drive-caredx-q3-growth-new-products-reach-market

outside_window.finding: FDA de novo decision on GraftAssureDx itself: the AI response window runs up to 180 days from late July 2026 (to ~late January 2027), after which FDA's remaining review clock resumes; the decision is not expected inside the exit window.

baseline_tension: No skew is available; the negatives agree with the steep 20-day run-down and 52-week-low tape, so much of them is plausibly already in the price, which is why p_up sits only 8 points below 50 despite two company-document negatives.
lessons_applied: Rule 1/7 (verified fact vs reaction; positioning): FDA-slip finding cut from -2.5 to -2.0 because the stock is already -30% over 20 sessions and at its 52-week low.

Rule 4 (financing is a question): asked what a raise would buy; no corroborated ramp (no kit revenue until FDA, FDA slipping), so the financing negative stays at -3.0; short interest checked (10% of float, 4 days), not crowded, no squeeze shrink.
Rule 2 (one-offs as one-offs): Chronix earnout remeasurement cut from +0.5 to +0.3; only a CNI Monitor sale would give it a cash path.
Rule 5 (proxy small): CareDx read-through cut from +0.3 to +0.2 and labelled a proxy.
Rule 6 (bar): revenue/EPS bar is single-source, so no finding rests on the revenue line; the FDA and cash bars are company-sourced.
